About Hofkoh Saigon Teacher day in Vietnam Written by Matthias in Study Our department celebrates teacher day on November 18th, two days earlier. Then almost all students fit into the 600 seat auditorium. We are still not complete, Dinh is still on a business trip in China. But we have fun!
